title: Interfaces parity: Wireless + WWAN form-first editors
acceptance_criteria: Backend exposes scoped wrappers for `interfaces wireless` and `interfaces wwan` without replacing existing service layers.
Wireless page supports GUI CRUD for core WLAN/AP settings, WPA ciphers/passphrase/RADIUS, and key HT capability toggles.
WWAN page supports GUI CRUD for APN, addressing, DHCP option leaves, and IPv4/IPv6 per-interface tuning controls.
Interfaces navigation, side menu, page guides, and runtime smoke routes include the new wireless and wwan pages.
Validation gates pass: backend tests, frontend typecheck, targeted eslint, frontend build, and runtime smoke.
assumptions: Wireless/WWAN hardware may be absent on many test nodes, so both pages must remain usable in pre-stage mode with clear capability warnings.
Wireless option-depth beyond core WPA/HT and WWAN DHCPv6-PD/operational modem controls remains follow-up parity work.
Playwright browser smoke remains blocked on this host due missing system shared libraries (libnspr4.so).

tasks.notes: Implemented wireless router/page with country-code support, core AP/station settings, WPA and RADIUS controls, and HT capability toggles.
Implemented WWAN router/page with APN, addressing, DHCP options, and IPv4/IPv6 interface tuning controls.
Added navigation links, how-to guides, and smoke route coverage for wireless/wwan pages.
Next queue: deepen remaining interface-family option parity (ethernet/pppoe/loopback/wireguard plus advanced wireless/wwan depth).
